name: ecommerce-promotions
description: The merchant's standing rules for reducing what a shopper pays, the evaluation of those rules against one basket, and the append-only record that a rule was spent on an order.
features: Offers as standing merchant rules, with a live status and an append-only decision log
Codes as a separate way of reaching an offer, unique per merchant, many or none per offer
Basket entitlement quoting that writes nothing and is never stored
Per-line allocation by largest remainder, summing to the entitlement total exactly
Free shipping published as a real reduction, separate from the line allocation
Buy X get Y discounting the cheapest qualifying units
Append-only redemptions with race-free usage limits enforced by conditional update
Redemption releases that give a use back when an order is cancelled or refunded
Optional customer-eligibility and product-grouping seams that fail only the offers that name them
Customer reference redaction that keeps the redemption, its lines and its release
